title: Launch Wave Root Env Trigger Fix 2026-06-20
purpose: Fix launch_wave dispatcher child environment selection so RCX_ROLE_AGENT_OVERRIDE_REPO_ROOT alone scopes inherited overrides but does not create an env-bearing runner call when no role or pager override is present.
evidence_command: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python3 -m pytest -q mu/tests/tools/test_launch_wave.py::test_launch_omitted_pins_preserve_runner_environment_shape mu/tests/tools/test_launch_wave.py::test_launch_partial_pins_scrub_stale_parent_override_env --tb=short && python3 tools/checks/linters/check_private_attr_access.py . mu/tests/tools/test_launch_wave.py && python3 mu/tools/checks/check_host_semantics_ratchet.py --json
evidence_delta: (1) launch_wave distinguishes role/pager override trigger keys from the root scoping key, so RCX_ROLE_AGENT_OVERRIDE_REPO_ROOT alone cannot force an env-bearing dispatcher launch. (2) The root scoping key is still scrubbed whenever a child env is needed for real inherited role/pager overrides. (3) Focused launcher tests cover omitted pins with a root-only parent env and partial pins that must still scrub stale parent overrides.
progress_proof_before: Pre-push failed repeatedly in unrelated waves because test_launch_omitted_pins_preserve_runner_environment_shape expected runner kwargs without env, while launch_wave treated RCX_ROLE_AGENT_OVERRIDE_REPO_ROOT alone as an inherited override trigger and passed a large child env into the runner.
progress_proof_after: A root-only parent scope variable no longer changes launch runner kwargs for omitted pins, while real role/pager overrides still trigger sanitized child env propagation.
scope_summary: Pipeline launcher/control-plane test fix only. Do not touch runtime, substrate, seed, scheduler, registry, projection, StructuralNumbers, autoping watcher behavior, pager route semantics, role agent config defaults, or tmux scripts.
